theme.style: A warm, celebratory world built from late-afternoon light: creamy sand, warm coral, and deep plum tones that feel like a hand-written card and a birthday candle glow rather than a cold utility app. Soft paper-grain textures, gentle radiating light rings, and hand-drawn ribbon motifs give it an intimate, personal warmth. Lighting is always soft and golden or dusky, never harsh or clinical, evoking gatherings, gifts, and remembered moments.
